desc.zh: 把两个形状相同的向量逐个分量相加：几何上，第二支箭头接在第一支的箭头尖上，和从起点指到终点。
desc.en: Adds two vectors of one shape entry by entry: drawn, the second arrow starts at the tip of the first, and the sum runs from the start to the end.

desc.zh: 数 k 乘向量 v 的每个分量：箭头沿原来的直线伸长或缩短 k 倍，k 为负时掉头。
desc.en: Multiplies every entry of the vector v by the number k: the arrow stretches or shrinks k times along its own line, and turns round when k is negative.
Gives the number it is set to.
